title: PORT-BRANCH-parked-claude-thread-front-door: carry parked/claude/thread-front-door onto main
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** branch `parked/claude/thread-front-door` at 261774b33d holds work main lacks and cannot merge as is (conflicts in code: agents/AGENTS.md, agents/PROJECT-INSTRUCTIONS.md, seed/agents/AGENTS.md, site/site.test.mjs, site/worker.js)
**Done check:** probe:git rev-list --count origin/main..origin/parked/claude/thread-front-door is 0, or the branch's content is carried by a merged change
**Status:** open

Port the change by hand onto current main (it is 3 commit(s) ahead), keeping tests green; then the sweep deletes the branch.

size: M

**Closing probe:** python3 -m foundation branchsweep --scan --json shows no `port` for parked/claude/thread-front-door
